batches.title: Offline Interactive Scene Foundation
batches.status: development build; manual browser QA pending
implemented: Canvas projected 3D-style scene with grid
Orbit and zoom interactions
Cube/sphere/pillar editing
Object selection and transformations
Scene JSON import/export with schema validation
Local structural QA
batches.regression_note: Standalone Module 13 file; no changes to Module 12 Batch 15

batches.name: WebGL Scene Engine & Advanced Object Controls
batches.preserves: Module 13 Batch 1 canvas editor and JSON import/export
implemented: Native WebGL 1 shader-based 3D cube/pillar and low-poly sphere previews
Canvas fallback toggle
Orbit/zoom WebGL interactions
GPU depth testing
Context-loss fallback
Existing object transforms and JSON import/export retained
limitations: WebGL availability depends on browser/GPU
Manual browser QA pending
No WebXR headset support or camera AR
No production deployment

batches.name: Scene Presets, Object Duplication & Offline Local Save
implemented: Three preset scenes: showroom, gallery, architecture
Duplicate selected object with unique ID
Explicit browser-local save, load and clear
Scene schema validation on local load
Existing Canvas and WebGL preview preserved
limitations: Local save is browser-specific and may be unavailable in private browsing
No automatic cloud synchronization
No WebXR or camera AR

batches.name: Bounded Undo/Redo Scene History
implemented: Undo and redo controls for scene edits
Ctrl/Cmd+Z and Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Z shortcuts outside text inputs
40-step bounded in-memory history
History controls update disabled state
Preserves existing scene schema, WebGL/Canvas renderer, presets and local storage
limitations: History is in-memory only and resets on reload
Asynchronous JSON import and local load are not yet tracked
Fine-grained slider inputs each create a history entry

batches.name: Camera View Presets
implemented: Front, Side and Top camera view buttons
Camera preset changes use existing scene view state and Undo/Redo history
Existing zoom level retained when switching camera views
Canvas and WebGL previews continue using shared view state
limitations: Top view pitch is limited to the existing 1.2 radian camera clamp
Manual browser regression QA still required

batches.name: Read-only Scene Inspector & Statistics
implemented: Live object count grouped by cube, sphere and pillar
Selected object ID, type, position and scale readout
Canvas or WebGL renderer mode indicator
Read-only inspector preserves scene schema, local save, JSON import/export and Undo/Redo
limitations: Browser interaction and renderer mode toggling require manual QA
Statistics are for current in-browser scene only

batches.name: Session Camera Bookmark & Restore
implemented: Bookmark current camera yaw, pitch and zoom
Restore saved camera viewpoint without changing scene objects
Restore action participates in existing Undo/Redo history
Restore disabled until bookmark exists
No changes to scene JSON schema or local save
limitations: Bookmark is in-memory and clears on reload
Only one bookmark is supported
Manual Canvas/WebGL regression testing required

batches.name: Session Object Visibility Controls
implemented: Hide or show selected scene object without deletion
Show All restores hidden objects
Hidden objects omitted from Canvas and WebGL preview and canvas picking
Object list marks hidden objects; inspector shows visible count
Visibility state remains session-only; scene JSON schema and local storage unchanged
limitations: Visibility is session-only and resets on scene reload or Undo/Redo scene restore
Visibility changes are not individually undoable
Manual browser QA and regression testing required

batches.name: Session Object Lock & Editing Protection
implemented: Lock and unlock selected object; Unlock All
Locked object remains selectable and visible but cannot be moved or scaled via sliders
Remove and Duplicate blocked for locked object at both UI and handler levels
Object list shows Locked marker
Lock state is session-only; no scene schema or database changes
limitations: Locks reset on scene load, reset, or undo/redo scene restoration
Lock/unlock is not itself undoable
Browser regression testing pending

batches.name: Object Search & Scene Navigator
implemented: Search object list by case-insensitive ID or object type
Live filtered count without changing scene objects
Select objects from filtered results
Preserve selection, locks, visibility, Canvas/WebGL rendering and saved scene format
Clear search to restore full object list
limitations: Search matches only object ID and type, not coordinates
Manual browser QA and regression testing required

batches.name: Scene Navigator Filters & Sorting
implemented: Filter scene navigator by cube, sphere or pillar
Filter by visible, hidden, locked or unlocked status
Sort navigator by object ID ascending or descending, or original scene order
Combine search text with status and type filters
Navigator filtering never changes scene data, renderer order or JSON format
limitations: Sorting is lexical with numeric comparison on IDs, not scene depth
Filters and sorting are not persisted across reload
Manual browser regression testing required

batches.name: Scene Navigator Quick Actions
implemented: Per-object Hide/Show button directly in navigator
Per-object Lock/Unlock button directly in navigator
Accessible action labels include object IDs
Quick actions refresh inspector and Canvas/WebGL preview
Existing search, type/status filters and sorting retained; scene schema unchanged
limitations: Quick action changes remain session-only and are not independently undoable
Changing status may remove object from currently filtered list
Manual browser QA and regression testing pending

batches.name: Navigator Reset & Selection Tools
implemented: Reset search, type filter, status filter and sorting in one action
Clear currently selected object without deleting it
Disable Clear Selection when no object is selected
Preserve scene objects, camera, visibility, locks, Canvas/WebGL and JSON schema
limitations: Clear Selection changes only active selection; it does not clear scene contents
Manual browser and regression testing required

batches.name: Previous & Next Object Navigation
implemented: Previous and Next controls traverse current filtered and sorted navigator list
Navigation changes selection only and updates inspector and scene highlight
Navigation buttons disable at list boundaries or when list is empty
Works alongside existing search, type/status filters, sorting, Hide/Show and Lock/Unlock
No changes to scene schema, saved JSON, database or rendering algorithms
limitations: Navigation uses current list order and does not wrap around
If no selected item is in filtered results, Next selects first and Previous selects last
Manual browser and regression QA required

batches.name: First & Last Object Navigation
implemented: First Object and Last Object controls use current filtered and sorted navigator list
Buttons disable at list boundaries and when no objects match
Selection-only navigation updates inspector and scene preview
Existing Previous/Next, filters, search, visibility and locks preserved
No scene schema, database or JSON export changes
limitations: Navigation does not wrap around
Manual browser and regression QA required

batches.name: Selection Status & Quick Focus
implemented: Navigator shows selected object ID and type
Status indicates when current filters exclude selected object
Find Selected in List clears search/type/status filters while retaining sort order
Scrolls to selected object and focuses its Select button
Selection and scene data remain unchanged; existing navigation preserved
limitations: Find Selected scrolls the navigator entry, not the 3D camera
Manual browser regression testing required

batches.name: Scene Navigator Keyboard Shortcuts
implemented: ArrowUp and ArrowDown navigate previous and next object from focused navigator buttons
Home and End select first and last object in current filtered and sorted list
Keyboard events scoped to object list, avoiding interference with form fields and canvas
Keyboard focus moves to selected object's Select button after navigation
Keyboard help text and accessible list description added
limitations: Keyboard navigation requires focus on a button inside object list
Manual browser and regression QA required

batches.name: Navigator Position & Empty State
implemented: Show selected object's position within currently filtered and sorted navigator list
Explain when selection is outside current filter results
Display explicit empty state when no objects match
Offer Clear Filters action through existing navigator reset logic
Keep scene, rendering, object selection and JSON schema unchanged
limitations: Position counts filtered navigator entries, not scene depth
Manual browser regression QA required

batches.name: Object Counts & Selection Summary
implemented: Read-only total object count in Scene Navigator
Visible and hidden object counts based on current session visibility state
Locked object count based on current session lock state
Filtered object count based on current search, type, status and sorting selection
Counts update when objects, filters, visibility or lock state change; no scene schema changes
limitations: Counts reflect current in-memory scene/session and do not persist lock or visibility state
Manual browser and regression QA required

batches.name: Object Type Breakdown & Quick Filters
implemented: Live per-type Cube, Sphere and Pillar object counts
All Types quick filter with total object count
Type shortcut buttons synchronize existing type filter
Active type shortcut exposes aria-pressed state
Preserves search, status filter, sort, keyboard navigation and scene schema
limitations: Quick type shortcuts change only the Navigator filter, not scene contents
Manual browser and regression QA required

batches.name: Visibility & Lock Quick Filters
implemented: Quick status buttons for All, Visible, Hidden, Locked and Unlocked objects
Per-status live counts reflect current in-memory scene and session states
Active quick status button reflects current status dropdown via aria-pressed
Shortcuts synchronize existing status filter without modifying scene objects
Preserves type quick filters, search, sorting, keyboard navigation and Canvas/WebGL
limitations: Visibility and lock states remain session-only
Quick status buttons only filter navigator entries; manual browser QA pending

batches.name: Scene Navigator Filter Presets
implemented: Save up to ten named in-memory combinations of Search, Type, Status and Sort
Select and apply a saved preset to restore navigator filtering
Delete selected preset without altering current filters
Preset controls expose disabled states and accessible status messages
No scene data, export schema, rendering, history or database changes
limitations: Presets are intentionally lost on page reload
Presets are not shared between users or browsers
Manual browser and regression QA required

batches.name: Preset Rename & Update
implemented: Rename an existing selected navigator filter preset using the preset name input
Update an existing preset with current Search, Type, Status and Sort settings
Preserve selected preset across rename
Disable rename and update actions when no preset is selected
Preserve 10-preset limit and in-memory session-only storage; scene objects and rendering untouched
limitations: Preset changes are not persisted across page reload
Manual browser and regression QA required

batches.name: Navigator Filter Preset JSON Import & Export
implemented: Export session navigator presets using a versioned JSON schema
Import validated JSON without overwriting existing named presets
Reject invalid schema/version/filter values, duplicate names, files over 64 KB and imports exceeding ten presets
Preserve Canvas and WebGL rendering, scene JSON format, navigator quick filters, rename/update/apply/delete
Fix pre-existing Undo/Redo capture-phase timing by scheduling snapshots after click/input handlers

automated_browser_qa.covered: Presets export/import/validation/atomicity, filters, renderer toggle, scene edit and undo

limitations: No headset WebXR or camera AR
Navigator presets are session-only until explicitly exported
Manual user acceptance and live deployment verification pending

batches.name: Explicit Navigator Preset Local Backup & Restore
implemented: Explicit Save Presets Locally using browser localStorage
Explicit Restore Local Presets with Batch 24 schema and value validation
Atomic reject of duplicate names and restores exceeding 10 preset maximum
Clear Local Backup with confirmation while preserving current session presets
No automatic load, no scene schema changes, no server writes
limitations: LocalStorage may be unavailable in private or restricted browsing
Local backups are device/browser specific
A duplicate name blocks the entire restore without changing session presets

batches.name: Local Backup Inspection & Restore Readiness
implemented: Check browser-local backup without changing current scene or navigator presets
Validate stored backup against existing Batch 24 versioned JSON schema
Report number of stored presets, duplicate-name conflicts and free session slots
Show whether restore is currently permitted by conflict and 10-preset capacity checks
Keep existing explicit Save, Restore and Clear behavior unchanged
limitations: LocalStorage access depends on browser permissions
Readiness status reflects the current session at time of inspection
Manual browser QA required before release

batches.name: Read-Only Local Backup Preset Preview
implemented: Preview stored preset names and their Search, Type, Status and Sort values before restoring
Mark preset names conflicting with current session presets
Render untrusted backup text using DOM textContent instead of HTML injection
Validate backup size and schema before displaying
Use accessible show/hide preview with aria-expanded; no session or backup mutations
limitations: Browser localStorage may be restricted
Backup preview is read-only and does not resolve duplicate names
Batches 25–27 require browser regression QA before release

batches.name: Selective Local Backup Preset Restore
implemented: Select one saved navigator preset from validated local backup
Restore only the chosen preset into session without overwriting other presets
Reject duplicate names, invalid selections and restores beyond the 10-preset limit
Refresh backup selection after local save, preview and clear
Preserve original scene JSON, renderers, preset import/export and undo/redo
limitations: Restore is manual and local to the current browser
Backup contents may change between selection and restore; validation repeats on restore
Batches 25–28 browser regression remains pending
